items.title: Keep guidance subordinate to the task
items.subject: general
items.description: Preserve fixed goals, measured work, evidence identity and the host boundary.
items.use_when: A selected role needs the shared refiner constraints stated explicitly.
items.do_not_use_when: Looking for a task-specific oracle or permission to change an active contract.

items.title: Own a design through implementation
items.subject: general
items.description: Prepare an approach and measures, call the coding child, then obtain part acceptance.
items.use_when: Instantiating the reusable Designer for any specialty.
items.do_not_use_when: Assigning the Designer authority to create another Designer or decompose independent work.

items.title: General route for an unfamiliar task
items.subject: general
items.description: Derive task semantics, grounding and a bounded approach when no specialty fits.
items.use_when: A target is unfamiliar, mixed-domain or unsupported by the catalog.
items.do_not_use_when: Using general instructions as a substitute for missing acceptance evidence.

items.title: Find only decision-relevant guidance
items.subject: general
items.description: Select exact guidance with supported applicability, conflicts, rejection reasons and uncovered needs.
items.use_when: A caller names a missing design instruction, example or checking pattern.
items.do_not_use_when: Broad curation, keyword-only admission or importing arbitrary web text as instructions.
